observation.description: Fashionable DesignThis kids watch features a trendy and casual design, making it a perfect accessory for any child's outfit. Its pink silicone quartz wristwatch is not only stylish but also durable.Water ResistanceThe watch is not waterproof, but it has a water resistance depth of no more than 30 meters. This makes it suitable for everyday wear and protects it from getting damaged by water.Quartz MovementEquipped with quartz movement, this watch ensures precise timekeeping. It's a reliable tool that helps children keep track of their study time.Silicone BandThe watch comes with a silicone band
